system.description:
[Trigger: Action] You use this skill at the same time as you use [Song of Aid]. It is treated as if the SR of the simultaneously used [Song of Aid] skill is +1 (it may exceed the maximum SR). Once per scenario.〔CR11〕The effect at the time of activation is not applied. The spear has a hollow shaft, and can produce various sounds depending on how it is swung. If swung in time with a song, the sound echoes and enhances its effect.

Broken Magic Flute [Core Material] (30G) + Light Javelin (70G) + [Magic Catalyst 2] (20G) ×4 + Crafting Cost (90G)
